answer: Forge each identity's right to answer in a sequential delay: before every epoch, an agent must complete a verifiable delay function - a computation that cannot be parallelized, no matter how much hardware you throw at it. One identity costs minutes; a thousand clones cost a thousand sequential runs, like felling a timber forest one tree at a time instead of clear-cutting a meadow with machines. Parallel farms gain nothing, so the price of a fake scales with wall-clock time, not with GPUs.
